name: XFeat LiteRT
purpose: Dense learned local descriptors for StableAR visual correspondence

input.preprocess: grayscale resize to 640x480 followed by per-image InstanceNorm: (x-mean)/sqrt(var+1e-5)

stablear_policy.authority: visual evidence only; never moves a world anchor directly
stablear_policy.template_learning: explicit admission only after independent geometric acceptance
